openings.claim: Speculative: an indexed pocket may retain the weakly magnetic spare and support gloved swapping; its movable fourth-strip gate provides an edge-free handling point. Replace magnetic/friction dependence with contact boundaries: bolt drilled strips through existing slots, forming side capture/end stops behind the marked edge. Wire may recover gate hardware. Pickup requires accessible unmarked plate surface; the gate is not assumed to lift it.
openings.discriminator: Rival: friction-only cork-lined strip clamp. If capture supplies retention, the spare should stay within 1 mm with light seating pressure; reduced clamp pressure may allow drift. Equal success leaves distinction unresolved. Pocket drift, trapped extraction or slow gloved servicing defeats capability.
openings.probe: Map slots, clearance, exposed 30 mm edge and unmarked pickup using ruler/marker. Verify strip bendability, bolt fit and sub-millimetre pocket play; abandon if geometry prevents capture. Keep rails attached; never drill/cut/heat/glue plate/carriage, cover the marked edge or intrude into clearance. Within 80 fabrication minutes build at most pocket and cork-clamp rival using supplied strips/bolts/pads/tools. Within 20 observation minutes use ruler/stroke counter for up to three twenty-stroke runs each, recording displacement and qualitative seating pressure; use spare in the final run. Time up to three thick-gloved removal/return checks each: within 60 seconds, without marked-edge contact. Optional pull-scale comparison up to 10 N characterizes escape paths, not resistance to unknown stroke forces. Stop early on clearance intrusion or necessary edge contact.
openings.uncertainty: Slot dimensions/locations must permit mounting outside clearance; strips must be plier-formable and sufficiently stiff; available bolts/strips must support capture and a gloved gate without plate/carriage modification. Informative comparisons depend on stroke duration; otherwise fewer runs reduce confidence. Reduced magnetic dependence addresses the anomaly without proving retention/serviceability.

lineage.reason: Preserves speculative relation, complete rival/defeat tests, resource/stopping caveats, assumptions and declared uncertain fit.

decision: Bounded enabling experiment only; feasibility remains uncertain until mounting, capture and pickup geometry checks.
